name: 07009 · Cedar Grove, NJ
findings: ZIP 07009 (Cedar Grove) has 53 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07009 (Cedar Grove) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
